name: jobstack-mcp
description: Remote MCP connector for JobStack — a unified jobs-search API fusing official job-board feeds + ATS boards (USAJOBS, Adzuna, Jooble, The Muse, Reed, and Greenhouse/Lever/Ashby/Workable/SmartRecruiters behind one `ats` engine) into one flat Job shape, exposed as MCP tools for Claude/ChatGPT/any MCP client. The wrapped upstream is metered behind a RapidAPI proxy-secret guard; this connector authenticates its own outbound calls and applies a soft per-IP rate limit so the free MCP tier stays a discovery channel.
